text:
Alex (AE): starting a quick swarm for LumenAI POC. Customer sees TTFT ~700ms and occasional 429s during a 1k-request validation run. Theyre also flagged our SOC2 section and KMS flow in their Sec questionnaire. looping in @Noah @Rina.

Noah (SalesEng): thanks. env? model variant? any headers or sample payloads?

Alex (AE): hosted us-east-1, variant `rwd-medium`. sample: ```json
{"prompt":"Extract key error types from logs id=abcd-1234","max_tokens":100,"session":"sess-77"}
```
header: `x-company: lumenai-test`

Rina (SRE): quick look at traces shows repeated `kvcache=MISS` and `shard_queue_wait` spikes. also a cluster of `429` with code `SHARD_OVERLOAD` around 14:12 UTC. snippet:
```
[2026-04-05T14:12:01Z] req=0x9a3 kvcache=MISS shard=3 queue_wait_ms=72 batch_window_ms=58 variant=rwd-medium
[2026-04-05T14:12:01Z] req=0x9a6 kvcache=MISS shard=7 queue_wait_ms=68 batch_window_ms=62 variant=rwd-medium
[2026-04-05T14:12:02Z] req=0x9b2 kvcache=HIT  shard=3 queue_wait_ms=12 batch_window_ms=10 variant=rwd-medium
[2026-04-05T14:12:05Z] req=0x9f0 rate=429 reason=SHARD_OVERLOAD shard=3
```

Diego (Runtime): two root causes likely: 1) cache key variance from dynamic session IDs embedded in prompt -> low hit rate; 2) batch windows configured to favor latency but the scheduler still opens long windows when load bursts. Also routing jitter: we see some requests flip shard mid-prefetch.

Leah (Product): FYI the customers validation harness appends `session` and `id` on every prompt. propose sanitizing prompt on ingress (strip/replace variable tokens) for the POC. also add a route-specific `max_batch_window_ms=12` override.

Noah (SalesEng): security question: they want to confirm key separation for POC data. security-bot, can you post the KMS isolation doc and SOC2 attestation?

security-bot: uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/security/kms-isolation.md and https://internal.redwood/security/soc2-report-2026.pdf :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: the customer asked about POC credits vs upfront commit. we can offer a 4-week pilot with a refundable reserved pool. ballpark discount 18%.

Rina (SRE): mitigation steps I can run now: 1) temp route that pins `x-company=lumenai-test` to a single shard to increase cache locality; 2) throttle per-shard concurrent inflight to protect overloaded shards; 3) run a canary after sanitization.

Diego (Runtime): I'll prepare the canary config: sticky routing for the header, `max_batch_window_ms=12`, `kv_prefetch=true` to warm up common keys, and keep a 5-minute fallback to previous policy if errors spike.

Alex (AE): plan sounds good. Noah, ask customer to run a focused set of 200 idempotent requests (same prompt sans session IDs) so we can measure baseline vs after fixes.

Noah (SalesEng): will do, sending steps and a sample script.

Rina (SRE): scheduling the canary flip now. I'll post a before/after csv with TTFT percentiles and `kvcache_hit_rate`. expecting TTFT median drop from ~700ms to ~200-300ms if kvcache improves. run ETA ~25m.

Diego (Runtime): deploying sticky routing canary scoped to `lumenai-test` header. leaving prefetch enabled for 10 minutes to warm.

Leah (Product): I'll queue the ingress sanitizer as a fallback hook if customer cannot change their harness quickly. it will NFKC normalize and remove `session` and `id` patterns.

Alex (AE): summarized actions:
- Noah/Alex: coordinate customer to run normalized test payloads
- Diego: deploy sticky routing + reduce batch window + kv_prefetch canary
- Rina: run perf before/after and share traces/CSV
- Leah: add ingress sanitizer hook and docs for customer
- security-bot: provide KMS/SOC2 artifacts (done)
- billing-bot: send pilot credit/discount offer

Alex (AE): will update customer after Rina posts metrics. tagging folks for updates. :rocket:
